Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.count
Metrics.Description: Intune managed device fleet count, by compliance state and operating system.

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.encrypted.count
Metrics.Description: Intune managed devices reporting isEncrypted=true, by operating system.

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.os_version.count
Metrics.Description: Intune managed device fleet count, by operating system bucket and raw operatingSystemVersion (unbucketed full version string; osVersion="unknown" when the device reported none).

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.overview.dual_enrolled_device_count
Metrics.Description: Devices enrolled in both MDM and EAS (managedDeviceOverview cross-check, may lag the live count).

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.overview.enrolled_device_count
Metrics.Description: Total enrolled Intune device count (managedDeviceOverview cross-check, may lag the live count).

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.overview.mdm_enrolled_device_count
Metrics.Description: Devices enrolled in MDM (managedDeviceOverview cross-check, may lag the live count).

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.overview.total
Metrics.Description: Intune managedDeviceOverview device counts by operating system / Android management mode (Microsoft-aggregated cross-check, may lag the live count).

Metrics.Name: intune.devices.sync_staleness_seconds
Metrics.Description: Intune managed devices bucketed by time since lastSyncDateTime.
